hook: Seven new models at scalable price-performance
hookText: Seven new models at scalable price-performance

beats.say: Microsoft announced seven new AI models at Ignite 2026, positioned around scalable price-performance. Used by 4,000 customers, it’s 50x faster and 79x cheaper than GPT-6.1 Sol.
In a blind, side-by-side evaluation of frontend work, developers preferred MAI Code 2 over GPT-6 Sol 64% of the time.
MAI Image 2.7 is the best image editing model in the world, taking the 1 spot on Artificial Analysis, outperforming GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst at just one-fifth of the price.
